steps.text: Open the Google Play Store app. Make sure you use the Google account that paid.
Tap your profile picture, then Payments & subscriptions.
Tap the subscription you want to stop.
Tap Cancel subscription and follow the prompts.
steps.note: Check the end date the service shows. Payments stop on the date you set.

steps.text: Or sign in on the web at the Google Play subscriptions page.
steps.note: Use the same Google account that paid.

steps.text: A third party, including StopDate, cannot cancel a Google Play subscription for you.
steps.note: Only you can do this with your Google account.
